Here it scraps sun_flare+corona, one of the run's three fire tags, and the kit becomes [solar_lance, moss_filter+sieve, seed_bomb]: fire 2, and _resonances() (derived, recomputed on read, nothing stored and nothing to unwind) returns [] on the very next read. The lance lights the same oil under the same drill bot and NO hook runs, so the bot is not rooted: it takes the D3 avoid:["fire"] step off its burning tile, survives on 1 hp, walks (4,2) -> (3,2) -> (2,2) and bills the tender 2. That last {t: damage, who: player} is the positive pin, because a record can pin only what happens, never that a hook did not run - in the resonant world the machine is rooted in the fire and dies there, so it never reaches the tender at all
